jab munafiq log tumharay paas aatay hain to kehtay hain :  hum gawahi detay hain kay aap Allah kay Rasool hain  aur Allah janta hai kay aap waqaee uss kay Rasool hain , aur Allah ( yeh bhi ) gawahi deta hai kay yeh munafiq log jhootay hain .
enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana rakha hai ,   phir yeh log doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht hi buray hain woh kaam jo yeh log kertay rahey hain .

yeh sari baaten iss wajeh say hain kay yeh ( shuroo mein ba-zahir ) emaan ley aaye , phir enhon ney kufr apna liya , iss liye inn kay dilon per mohar laga di gaee , nateeja yeh kay yeh log ( haq baat ) samajhtay hi nahi hain .

jab tum inn ko dekho to inn kay deel dol tumhen boht achay lagen , aur agar woh baat keren to tum unn ki baaten suntay reh jao ,   unn ki misal aesi hai jaisay yeh lakriyan hain jo kissi saharay say lagi rakhi hain .   yeh her cheekh pukar ko apney khilaf samajhtay hain .   yehi hain jo ( tumharay ) dushman hain , iss liye inn say hoshiyar raho . Allah ki maar ho inn per ! yeh kahan ondhay chalay jarahey hain-?

aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay aao , Allah kay Rasool tumharay haq mein maghfirat ki dua keren , to yeh apney saron ko matkatay hain ,   aur tum enhen dekho gay kay woh baray ghamand kay aalam mein bey rukhi say kaam letay hain .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) inn kay haq mein dono baaten barabar hain , chahye tum inn kay liye maghfirat ki dua kero ya naa kero , Allah enhen hergiz nahi bakhshay ga .   yaqeen jano Allah aesay nafarman logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

yehi to hain jo kehtay hain kay jo log Rasool Allah kay paas hain unn per kuch kharch naa kero , yahan tak kay yeh khud hi muntashir hojayen gay ,   halankay aasmano aur zameen kay tamam khazaney Allah hi kay hain , lekin munafiq log samajhtay nahi hain .

kehtay hain kay :  agar hum madina ko loat ker jayen gay to jo izzat wala hai , woh wahan say zillat walay ko nikal bahir keray ga    halankay izzat to Allah hi ko hasil hai , aur uss kay Rasool ko , aur emaan walon ko , lekin munafiq log nahi jantay .
aey emaan walo ! tumhari dolat aur tumhari aulad tumhen Allah ki yaad say ghafil naa kernay payen . aur jo log aisa keren gay , woh baray ghatay ka soda kernay walay hon gay .

aur hum ney tumhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say ( Allah kay hukum kay mutabiq ) kharch kerlo , qabal iss kay kay tum mein say kissi kay paas moat aajaye to woh yeh kahey kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! tu ney mujhay thori dair kay liye aur mohlat kiyon naa dey di kay mein khoob sadqa kerta , aur naik logon  mein shamil hojata .
aur jab kissi shaks ka moyyan waqt aajaye ga to Allah ussay hergiz mohlat nahi dey ga , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
